✨ OSS-DocumentScanner | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a mobile application for easily scanning, digitizing, and managing physical documents on their Android devices.
✨ Key Features: • Document scanning and capture • Image enhancement for clarity • PDF conversion • Document organization
📖 Summary: OSS DocumentScanner is an Android application designed for efficient document scanning and management. It leverages advanced image processing techniques to capture, enhance, and organize documents, converting them into digital formats like PDFs.
